topic_meaning: Multiple romantic-interest vectors converge on one identifiable recipient; a group alone is insufficient.

hard_topic_gates.criterion: At least two separately identifiable interested people direct personal romantic attention or approaches toward the same identifiable recipient.
At least two interest vectors show mutually reinforcing cues of affection or personal courtship; a generic task handover or group smile alone is insufficient.
The recipient visibly participates in or reacts to more than one converging approach; prose about an imagined choice cannot substitute for visible interaction.
The interested people, shared recipient and carrying approach/attention connections are visible together in the same image.

authorial_checks.criterion: A robotics workshop and at least one plausible near-future technology cue remain visually readable.
The bob-haired romantic-interest character resembles the supplied portrait in short dark bob/fringe and facial impression at the available scale; no real identity or age claim is tested.
The gift handover and linked elbow trace to separate coherent owners with visible assessable boundaries.

interpretation_rules: Full topic pass requires all four topic gates visible and supported. Partial or unobservable evidence fails the full component gate. Authorial checks, candidate exposure, permitted adoption, exact transport, pixels and direct user acceptance are reported separately. Pending user acceptance is not acceptance.
